title: Verity
review: I’m not a huge fan of domestic dramas, but I still enjoyed it. A lot of the serious scenes are awkward and Johnson’s involvement really makes them feel right out of 50 Shades of Gray. It’s unintentionally funny which usually is a bad sign but that was the most enjoyable part for me. It’s better than other similar movies I’ve seen like The Housemaid and Swallow just from its complexity alone. I’ll have to rewatch a hot ones interview for this.

title: Digger
review:
Saw a sneak preview. Will my review even show up right now? We’ll see.

It’s a little pretentious on the surface level but that’s just there in an attempt to hide its true theme from the audience. The ending is very smart, it holds all its cards until after the credits roll. The screenplay is a well structured idea, and the cast is having a lot of fun with it.

title: Resident Evil
review: It's solid but not really up my alley. Just too many jump scares and horror cliches for me. Like bro doesn't make a single decisive action the whole movie he just moves verrrrry slowly. Still its better than what your usually get for a video game movie and that's mostly thanks to Cregger.

title: Bad Apples
review: Yessss. I was so right to have had this as my most anticipated movie for September. It’s such a banger. Built on a perfect metaphor, it’s as rich with double meaning as an apple pie. So many funny and unexpected moments as well. Had me from start to finish.

title: Hope
review: It’s a long hot mess but it’s actually pretty decent in the sci-fi action department. Several sequences go on way way way waaay too long but it also has several cool moments. Definitely one of those “what the fuck did I just watch” movies.

title: Irresistible
review: Huge yikes. I like Jon Stewart but this is a terrible movie goddamn…
